title: Training method and device of data classification and grading model and electronic equipment
abstract: The invention provides a training method and device for a data classification and grading model and electronic equipment. The method comprises the steps of selecting m corpora from a preset corpus to serve as training samples; preprocessing the m corpora according to a preset data classification and grading standard, converting each corpus into a corresponding data model, and determining data categories and data levels corresponding to the m corpora; encoding the data model corresponding to each corpus to obtain a feature matrix corresponding to each corpus; inputting the feature matrixes corresponding to the m corpora into a pre-established data classification and grading model to obtain prediction categories and prediction levels corresponding to the m corpora; determining a confusion matrix corresponding to the data classification and grading model; and repeatedly executing the above steps until the confusion matrix meets a preset condition, and obtaining a trained classification and grading model. According to the invention, model training can be carried out according to the preset data classification and grading standard, and the accuracy of the data classification and grading model is improved.
